Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, co As Object, ch As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    Case 1
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(0, 0, 48, 15)
    Case 2
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48.5, 15.5, 47, 14)
    Case 3
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    Case 4
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    Case 5
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    Case 6
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    Case 7
        Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200)
    End Select
    Set ch = co.Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    ch.HasTitle = True
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
    Case 2
    Case 3
        co.RoundedCorners = True
    Case 4
        co.RoundedCorners = True: co.RoundedCorners = False
    Case 5
        co.Shadow = True
    Case 6
        co.Shadow = True: co.Shadow = False
    Case 7
        ws.Columns("A:D").ColumnWidth = 20
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(co.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.TopLeftCell.Address
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.BottomRightCell.Address
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.RoundedCorners
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.Shadow
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ch.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ch.ChartGroups(1).Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).AxisGroup
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).Index
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).SeriesCollection(2).Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ch.ChartTitle.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ch.ChartTitle.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartTitle.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.Legend.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ch.Legend.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
